pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal dark-toned regions exhibiting stellate edge gradients. The boundaries are characterized by high-frequency pixel fluctuations and serrated transitions between the dark and light pelage. Relative spatial area of patches is larger on the flank compared to the neck.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Light-toned pathways forming a continuous topological graph. Junction nodes are primarily tri-radial and quadri-radial. The pixel thickness of the pathways is relatively consistent across the mid-flank but narrows significantly at the junction of the neck and shoulder.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the upper neck and shoulder exhibits a continuous, high-frequency, low-amplitude sawtooth silhouette against the background. The fringe is composed of dense, short, vertically oriented hair structures.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple thin, linear, light-colored textural disruptions are visible across several patches on the central flank, consistent with superficial epidermal abrasions or hair-grain irregularities.
